knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

```{r libraries}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggvenn)
library(cowplot)
```

```{r constants}
RIP_LFC_CUT  <- 1
RIP_PADJ_CUT <- 0.05
TE_LFC_CUT   <- 0.5
TE_PADJ_CUT  <- 0.05
```

```{r load_data}
tp_map <- list(
  normoxia_1hr = list(
    rip = here("ripseq", "output", "ripseq_deseq_normoxia_1hr_flag_eif3d_vs_igg.csv"),
    te  = here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_normoxia_1and4hr.csv")
  ),
  hypoxia_1hr = list(
    rip = here("ripseq", "output", "ripseq_deseq_hypoxia_1hr_flag_eif3d_vs_igg.csv"),
    te  = here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv")
  ),
  hypoxia_4hr = list(
    rip = here("ripseq", "output", "ripseq_deseq_hypoxia_4hr_flag_eif3d_vs_igg.csv"),
    te  = here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_4hr.csv")
  ),
  hypoxia_24hr = list(
    rip = here("ripseq", "output", "ripseq_deseq_hypoxia_24hr_flag_eif3d_vs_igg.csv"),
    te  = here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_24hr.csv")
  )
)

TP_LEVELS <- c("normoxia_1hr", "hypoxia_1hr", "hypoxia_4hr", "hypoxia_24hr")
```

```{r join}
join_tp <- function(paths, tp_name) {
  rip <- read_csv(paths$rip, show_col_types = FALSE)
  te  <- read_csv(paths$te,  show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

  inner_join(
    rip |> dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, rip_lfc = log2FoldChange, rip_padj = padj),
    te  |> dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, te_lfc, te_padj),
    by = "gene_id_clean"
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      rip_hit  = !is.na(rip_lfc) & rip_lfc > RIP_LFC_CUT & rip_padj < RIP_PADJ_CUT,
      ribo_hit = !is.na(te_lfc) & !is.na(te_padj) & te_lfc > TE_LFC_CUT & te_padj < TE_PADJ_CUT,
      timepoint = tp_name
    )
}

joined_list <- imap(tp_map, join_tp)
joined_nor  <- joined_list$normoxia_1hr
joined_hyp  <- joined_list$hypoxia_1hr
joined_all  <- bind_rows(joined_list) |>
  dplyr::mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = TP_LEVELS))

for (tp in TP_LEVELS) {
  df <- joined_list[[tp]]
  cat(tp, "| joined:", nrow(df),
      "| RIP hits:", sum(df$rip_hit),
      "| Riboseq hits:", sum(df$ribo_hit), "\n")
}
```

# Venn Diagrams

```{r venn_faceted, fig.width=16, fig.height=5}
venn_plots <- lapply(TP_LEVELS, function(tp_name) {
  df <- joined_list[[tp_name]]
  venn_list <- list(
    "FLAG3D RIP\n(LFC>1, padj<0.05)"   = df$gene_id_clean[df$rip_hit],
    "Riboseq TE\n(LFC>0.5, padj<0.05)" = df$gene_id_clean[df$ribo_hit]
  )
  ggvenn(venn_list,
         fill_color  = c("#E69F00", "#9E5F00"),
         stroke_size = 0.5,
         text_size   = 4.5) +
    ggtitle(tp_name) +
    theme_void(base_size = 16)
})

p_venn_grid <- plot_grid(plotlist = venn_plots, nrow = 1, labels = "AUTO")
p_venn_grid
ggsave(here("ripseq", "plots", "08_venn_faceted.pdf"),
       p_venn_grid, width = 16, height = 5)
```

# Odds Ratio and Fisher's Exact Test

```{r fisher}
ct_nor <- table(rip_hit = joined_nor$rip_hit, ribo_hit = joined_nor$ribo_hit)
ft_nor <- fisher.test(ct_nor)
cat("Normoxia OR:", round(ft_nor$estimate, 2),
    " 95% CI:", round(ft_nor$conf.int[1], 2), "-", round(ft_nor$conf.int[2], 2),
    " p =", signif(ft_nor$p.value, 3), "\n")

ct_hyp <- table(rip_hit = joined_hyp$rip_hit, ribo_hit = joined_hyp$ribo_hit)
ft_hyp <- fisher.test(ct_hyp)
cat("Hypoxia OR:", round(ft_hyp$estimate, 2),
    " 95% CI:", round(ft_hyp$conf.int[1], 2), "-", round(ft_hyp$conf.int[2], 2),
    " p =", signif(ft_hyp$p.value, 3), "\n")
```

```{r or_plot}
or_df <- tibble(
  condition = c("Normoxia", "Hypoxia"),
  OR        = c(ft_nor$estimate, ft_hyp$estimate),
  p_label   = c(paste0("p = ", signif(ft_nor$p.value, 2)),
                paste0("p = ", signif(ft_hyp$p.value, 2)))
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Normoxia", "Hypoxia")))

p_or <- ggplot(or_df, aes(x = condition, y = OR)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, fill = "#E69F00") +
  geom_text(aes(label = p_label), vjust = -0.4, size = 5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Odds ratio (RIP hit x Riboseq hit)",
       title = "eIF3d RIP vs riboseq overlap") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16)

p_or
ggsave(here("ripseq", "plots", "08_odds_ratio.pdf"), p_or, width = 4, height = 4)
```

# CDF: RIP-seq LFC by riboseq hit status, all 4 timepoints

```{r wilcox_labels}
wt_rip <- joined_all |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(rip_lfc)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(timepoint) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    p     = wilcox.test(rip_lfc ~ ribo_hit)$p.value,
    label = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(p, 3)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r cdf_rip_faceted, fig.width=14, fig.height=4}
p_cdf_rip <- joined_all |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(rip_lfc)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rip_lfc, color = ribo_hit)) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = wt_rip, aes(label = label),
            x = Inf, y = 0, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.4,
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "grey60", "TRUE" = "#E69F00"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Riboseq non-hit", "TRUE" = "Riboseq hit (TE LFC>0.5)")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ timepoint, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "log2FC (FLAG3D IP / IgG)", y = "Cumulative fraction",
       color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_cdf_rip
ggsave(here("ripseq", "plots", "08_cdf_rip_by_ribo_faceted.pdf"),
       p_cdf_rip, width = 14, height = 4)
```

# Density plots: eIF3d IP enrichment across timepoints

```{r load_iprna_08}
te_gene_files_08 <- c(
  here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_normoxia_1hr.csv"),
  here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
  here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_4hr.csv"),
  here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_24hr.csv")
)
te_universe_08 <- unique(unlist(lapply(te_gene_files_08, function(f)
  sub("\\..*", "", read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)$gene_id)
)))
cat("TE gene universe:", length(te_universe_08), "\n")

iprna_long <- read_csv(here("ripseq", "output", "18_ip_over_rna_enrichment.csv"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(ip_type == "flag_eif3d",
                !is.na(log2_ip_over_rna),
                gene_id_clean %in% te_universe_08) |>
  dplyr::mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = TP_LEVELS))
cat("IP/RNA rows after TE gene universe filter:", nrow(iprna_long), "\n")
```

```{r density_igg, fig.width=14, fig.height=4}
p_dens_igg <- ggplot(dplyr::filter(joined_all, !is.na(rip_lfc)), aes(x = rip_lfc)) +
  geom_density(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ timepoint, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "log2FC (eIF3d IP / IgG)", y = "Density",
       title = "eIF3d IP/IgG enrichment distribution by timepoint") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

p_dens_igg
ggsave(here("ripseq", "plots", "08_density_igg.pdf"), p_dens_igg, width = 14, height = 4)
```

```{r density_iprna, fig.width=14, fig.height=4}
p_dens_iprna <- ggplot(iprna_long, aes(x = log2_ip_over_rna)) +
  geom_density(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ timepoint, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "log2(eIF3d IP CPM / siCTRL RNA)", y = "Density",
       title = "eIF3d IP/RNA enrichment distribution by timepoint") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

p_dens_iprna
ggsave(here("ripseq", "plots", "08_density_iprna.pdf"), p_dens_iprna, width = 14, height = 4)
```

# Gene-set overlay: eIF3d-promoted mRNAs on enrichment distribution

```{r load_genesets_08}
promotes_hyp <- read_csv(
  here("output", "genesets", "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE) |> pull(ensembl_gene)

promotes_nor <- read_csv(
  here("output", "genesets", "normoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE) |> pull(ensembl_gene)

cat("Hypoxia-promoted genes:", length(promotes_hyp), "\n")
cat("Normoxia-promoted genes:", length(promotes_nor), "\n")
```

```{r overlay_igg_hyp, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
igg_hyp1 <- joined_all |>
  dplyr::filter(timepoint == "hypoxia_1hr", !is.na(rip_lfc)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(group = ifelse(gene_id_clean %in% promotes_hyp,
                               "eIF3d hypoxia promotes", "Other"))

n_labels_igg_hyp <- c(
  "eIF3d hypoxia promotes" = paste0("eIF3d hypoxia promotes (n=", sum(igg_hyp1$group == "eIF3d hypoxia promotes"), ")"),
  "Other"                  = paste0("Other (n=", sum(igg_hyp1$group == "Other"), ")")
)

p_overlay_igg_hyp <- ggplot(igg_hyp1, aes(x = rip_lfc, color = group)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("eIF3d hypoxia promotes" = "#E69F00", "Other" = "grey40"),
                     labels = n_labels_igg_hyp) +
  labs(x = "log2FC (eIF3d IP / IgG, hypoxia 1hr)", y = "Density",
       color = NULL,
       title = "eIF3d hypoxia-promoted targets: IP/IgG distribution") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_overlay_igg_hyp
ggsave(here("ripseq", "plots", "08_overlay_igg_hypoxia_promotes.pdf"),
       p_overlay_igg_hyp, width = 6, height = 5)
```
